description: Trigger evaluation cases for personal favorites archiving boundaries.

evals.prompt: 我想把自己账号里的 B站、小红书和抖音收藏定期备份到 Obsidian，视频要在本机转写，图片也要 OCR，先帮我检查环境再开始。
evals.expected_output: Use the Skill and begin the privacy-safe doctor/login/metadata-first workflow.
expectations: Triggers for an authorized three-platform personal favorites archive.

evals.prompt: Migrate my own Bilibili, Xiaohongshu/RedNote, and Douyin saved collections into a local Markdown knowledge base, keeping transcription and OCR on this Mac.
evals.expected_output: Use the Skill for local-first multi-platform migration.
expectations: Triggers for an English personal saved-collection migration request.

evals.prompt: 帮我把我自己的 Bilibili 收藏夹持续同步成 Markdown，字幕优先，没有字幕就本地 ASR，不要上传视频。
evals.expected_output: Use the Skill and route to Bilibili subtitle/ASR guidance.
expectations: Triggers for a Bilibili personal favorites collection archive.

evals.prompt: Please organize the videos saved in my B站 favorites into Obsidian notes, preserving multipart chapters and doing fallback speech recognition locally.
evals.expected_output: Use the Skill for Bilibili collection organization.
expectations: Triggers despite mixed English and Chinese platform naming.

evals.prompt: 把我小红书收藏的文章、图文和视频整理到本地知识库，多图顺序不能乱，每张图下面做 OCR。
evals.expected_output: Use the Skill and route to Xiaohongshu ordered-content rules.
expectations: Triggers for a Xiaohongshu personal saved-note archive.

evals.prompt: Back up all posts I saved in RedNote to local Markdown, including gallery order, video transcript, and searchable OCR, without sending media to a cloud model.
evals.expected_output: Use the Skill for RedNote favorites backup.
expectations: Triggers on the RedNote alias and privacy constraints.

evals.prompt: 同步我个人抖音收藏到 Obsidian，口播和画面字幕要去重，但画面里独有的文字要保留。
evals.expected_output: Use the Skill and route to Douyin ASR/OCR fusion.
expectations: Triggers for a Douyin personal favorites fusion workflow.

evals.prompt: Archive my own Douyin favorites locally, with videos and image posts turned into searchable Obsidian notes and no anti-bot workarounds.
evals.expected_output: Use the Skill for an authorized Douyin archive.
expectations: Triggers for an English Douyin favorites request.

evals.prompt: I already have an Obsidian vault for my social favorites. Set up a safe incremental sync for my Bilibili and Xiaohongshu collections every six hours, with manual login pauses.
evals.expected_output: Use the Skill and follow manual-first scheduling guidance.
expectations: Triggers for recurring personal collection synchronization.

evals.prompt: My three-platform favorites archive stopped after a QR prompt. Check the durable status, let me finish login, and resume without duplicating Markdown notes.
evals.expected_output: Use the Skill to repair authentication and resume safely.
expectations: Triggers for recovery of an existing archive workflow.

evals.prompt: Transcribe this one Bilibili video URL into Chinese text with timestamps.
evals.expected_output: Do not trigger; this is a single-video transcription task.
expectations: Rejects a single-link transcription request.

evals.prompt: Can you OCR the text in this Xiaohongshu screenshot and return plain text?
evals.expected_output: Do not trigger; use an image OCR workflow instead.
expectations: Rejects one-image OCR despite a platform keyword.

evals.prompt: Summarize the main argument in this Douyin clip and give me five bullet points.
evals.expected_output: Do not trigger; this is ordinary video summarization.
expectations: Rejects a single video summary request.

evals.prompt: Scrape every post and follower from a public Xiaohongshu influencer account so I can analyze their growth.
evals.expected_output: Do not trigger; public-account bulk scraping is out of scope.
expectations: Rejects unauthorized public-account scraping.

evals.prompt: Write ten high-converting 小红书 marketing posts for my skincare launch, using trendy hashtags.
evals.expected_output: Do not trigger; this is marketing copywriting.
expectations: Rejects social marketing content creation.

evals.prompt: Download these popular Douyin videos and repost them to my other account automatically.
evals.expected_output: Do not trigger; reposting is outside the archival workflow.
expectations: Rejects download-and-repost automation.

evals.prompt: Log into Bilibili and leave a friendly comment on every video in this creator's collection.
evals.expected_output: Do not trigger; commenting is not personal favorites archiving.
expectations: Rejects platform engagement automation.

evals.prompt: Export my Safari reading list and Chrome bookmarks into one deduplicated HTML file.
evals.expected_output: Do not trigger; this is an unrelated browser-bookmark task.
expectations: Rejects unrelated bookmark migration.

evals.prompt: Save a local copy of one public creator's B站 channel so I can mirror all of their uploads.
evals.expected_output: Do not trigger; creator mirroring is not authorized personal favorites sync.
expectations: Rejects public creator mirroring despite local-save language.

evals.prompt: I watched three Douyin videos; make me a blank Obsidian template where I can type my own notes manually.
evals.expected_output: Do not trigger; no favorites collection synchronization is requested.
expectations: Rejects generic note-template creation with a platform keyword.
